scope: Independent continuous averaged, per-unit single-converter reproduction of the DO-GFM equations, GFM/GFL transition, frequency droop, and inductance mismatch. The existing motulator replay is a separate sampled/PWM baseline.

implementation.physical_model: Eqs. (1), (2), (4), (5), lossless averaged plant in tau = 2*pi*50*t. Nominal-frequency coordinates use Eq. (18), grid-frequency coordinates use Eq. (10). Theoretical quasi-static voltage uses instantaneous grid frequency.
implementation.limiter: Eq. (15) and Eq. (20), 1.3 pu current-reference magnitude. The paper gives this value for Fig. 8; its reuse in normal-mode ideal simulations is explicit. Both unlimited and applied current reference are observable.
implementation.resistance: Main analytical/dynamic comparisons are lossless per Section II. Only the comparison trace includes physical command Vhat+e+0.05*I for the matched-resistance interpretation used in the existing motulator replay. The compensation sign in V-C is discussed in the source audit.
implementation.sequence_initialization: Low-angle equilibrium for the initial reference. Retain the observer state through mode switches. Segment the integration at every reference or mode change and frequency-ramp breakpoint.
implementation.l_in_pu: Use stated per-unit L and Lhat for analytical cases, rather than reconverting rounded Table I SI inductance.

power_sequence.source: Weak Fig. 6(b) reference digitization in the existing case. Reuse the same sequence across L for like-for-like controller comparisons.

mode_sequence.name: mode_fig10
mode_sequence.source: Fig. 10 events and Table II gains. Study ideal mode change and P/Q decoupling.

not_reproduced: Exact laboratory PWM, dead time, plant resistance, sensing delays, grid emulator and DC source dynamics. Public vector curves are figure data.
